items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, he told Whitney Balliett they played -- his father and your father played music together in New Orleans.

ctx.x: of that, but maybe that's why when I met Red Allen, he was so friendly with me. He knew something I didn't. But no, I didn't know that. I wasn't aware of that.
Yeah, he told Whitney Balliett they played -- his father and your father played music together in New Orleans.
Well, they probably did, because you know, my dad was quite a good musician, you know.
